update_interval.description: How often (in seconds) conky refreshes its display.

font.description: Font to use for text rendering (Pango font description).

colors.description: Color scheme for UI elements — can be named X11 colors (e.g., 'white') or hex (#RRGGBB).

alert.description: Color for warnings or critical values.

alignment.description: Where the conky window appears on screen.

gap_x.description: Horizontal gap (px) between the window edge and screen edge.

gap_y.description: Vertical gap (px) between the window edge and screen edge.

minimum_width.description: Minimum width (px) of conky window. 0 = auto.

minimum_height.description: Minimum height (px) of conky window. 0 = auto.

use_xft.description: Enable Xft (anti-aliased fonts) support. Required for complex fonts.

override_utf8_locale.description: Force UTF-8 locale for proper Unicode character rendering.

custom_variables.description: List of user-defined variables (key-value pairs) for reuse in monitor blocks.

monitor_blocks.description: Ordered list of monitor sections to display. Each block defines content and parameters.

content.description: Raw text (for 'text' blocks). Escape newlines and quotes as needed.

disks.description: List of filesystem paths to monitor (for 'disk' blocks).

path.description: Mount point or path to filesystem.

processes.description: List of process info entries (for 'process' blocks).

name.description: Label for the process (ignored by conky, for your reference).

script.description: Shell or Lua command to execute (for 'custom' blocks).
